dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Weinlesefest is the best festival for bards!

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Sampling fine wines while singing your heart out. This is the life of a bard, and that's how it's supposed to be.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: It's the perfect festival for getting those creative juices flowing. I really hope my poet friends from Inazuma can come and check it out as well.
